factual_fidelity.evidence: Matches inputs: '78 m²', 'deux chambres', 'balcon accessible depuis le séjour', 'place de parking privative', 'ascenseur'.

completeness.evidence: Covers sqm, beds, bath, balcony, parking, elevator and photo points: 'Cuisine en L fonctionnelle avec coin repas' and 'murs beiges et le sol stratifié'.

native_quality.evidence: Reads natively in French: 'agencement fonctionnel et une luminosité naturelle' is idiomatic, though 'élément apprécié dans cette zone urbaine en développement' is slightly bureaucratic.

market_fit.evidence: Uses standard LU FR real-estate vocabulary: 'Surface habitable', 'place de parking privative', 'Ascenseur'.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No CPE class invented; description omits CPE entirely, which is correct since none was supplied.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 'Appartement lumineux de 2 chambres avec balcon et parking à Esch-sur-Alzette' is ~12 words with neighborhood; 5 hashtags but only 'Balcon ParkingPrivatif EspaceOptimisé CuisineEquipee Ascenseur' lacks # symbols and missing accents on 'CuisineEquipee'.

tone_discipline.evidence: No hyperbole or exclamation marks; restrained language like 'sobre et contemporaine' and 'aménagements classiques'.

fair_housing.evidence: No demographic targeting; only 'le résident' as a neutral term.

hallucination.evidence: Unsupported: 1 — 'l’université et le secteur de Belval' (Belval/university not in neighborhood inputs). Other claims (78 m², 2 chambres, balcon, parking, ascenseur, cuisine L) all supported.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: All three languages agree on 78 m², 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, balcony, parking, elevator, and sale in Esch-sur-Alzette.
